title: Defence highlights — [Jan]+[Feb] merged**: DRDO's LR-AShM hypersonic glide missile (Republic Day debut); Indian Army's 'Bhairav' drone-warfare force (over 1 lakh trained operatives); Agni-III IRBM test (ITR Chandipur, ~3,000-3,500 km range); India's nuclear stockpile ranks **6th globally, 180 warheads** (FAS report; Russia leads 4,309); President Murmu flies LCH 'Prachand' (first Indian President to fly India's indigenous combat helicopter); **PRAHAAR** — MHA's new national counter-terrorism policy.
